HTTP 403 with x-datadome: protected and a Set-Cookie: datadome=... header; body is the
DataDome captcha redirect ({"url": "https://geo.captcha-delivery.com/captcha/?..."}), i.e. the
Blocked path. A happy-path web JSON could not be captured from this network.
